# LocalAgents

> LocalAgents syncs OpenCode sessions between your computers. Start a session on one PC, push it, and pull it on another. A web inbox lists every session and lets you approve tool calls from your phone.

Install: npx localagents login

## Product

- [Home](https://localagents.link): What LocalAgents does, how it works, and pricing.
- Pricing: Pro is $9 per month or $90 per year. The first 30 days are free and require no card.

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](https://localagents.link/legal/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://localagents.link/legal/privacy)
- [Refund Policy](https://localagents.link/legal/refunds)

## Notes

- Supported agent: OpenCode. Session files from v1 and v2 are both read.
- The web inbox does not run a terminal. Approvals and instructions are relayed to the PC, which executes them.
